story_targets.narrative_hook: The greatest World Cup final of all time: Messi's legacy finale vs Mbappe's hat-trick defiance

events.description: Messi scores penalty to put Argentina 1-0 up after Di Maria was fouled by Dembele
Di Maria finishes a sweeping team move to make it 2-0 Argentina. Mac Allister and Alvarez combine before Di Maria dinks it over Lloris
Half time. Argentina 2-0 France. France yet to register a shot
Mbappe scores penalty to pull one back for France after Otamendi fouls Kolo Muani
Mbappe scores a stunning volley 97 seconds later to equalise 2-2. Thuram provides the assist
Full time. Argentina 2-2 France. Extra time to follow
Messi scores from close range after Martinez saves his initial shot to put Argentina 3-2 up. Lautaro Martinez provides the assist
Mbappe scores his second penalty of the final to equalise 3-3 after a Montiel handball
Extra time full time. Argentina 3-3 France. Penalty shootout awaits
Mbappe scores France's first penalty. France 1-0 in shootout
Messi scores Argentina's first penalty. Shootout tied 1-1
Martinez saves Coman's penalty. France 1-1 in shootout
Dybala scores Argentina's second penalty. Argentina 2-1 in shootout
Martinez saves Kolo Muani's penalty. Argentina 2-1 in shootout
Montiel scores the winning penalty. Argentina win the World Cup 4-2 on penalties
Argentina lift the FIFA World Cup trophy for the first time since 1986. Messi lifts the trophy and celebrates with the squad
